parts.passageHtml:
{[Knowing your communication style and having a mix of styles on your team can provide a positive force for resolving conflict.][198697]}

{[Section A][198718]}

{[As far back as Hippocrates’ time (460-370 BC), people have tried to understand other people by characterizing them according to personality type or temperament.][198721]} {[Hippocrates believed there were four different body fluids that influenced four basic types of temperament.][198745]} {[His work was further developed 500 years later by Galen.][198761]} {[These days there are a number of self-assessment tools that relate to the basic descriptions developed by Galen, although we no longer believe the source to be the types of body fluid that dominate our systems.][198772]}

{[Section B][198809]}

{[The values in self-assessments that help determine personality style.][198813]} {[Learning styles, communication styles, conflict-handling styles, or other aspects of individuals is that they help depersonalize conflict in interpersonal relationships.][198823]} {[The depersonalization occurs when you realize that others aren’t trying to be difficult, but they need different or more information than you do.][198843]} {[ They’re not intending to be rude: they are so focused on the task they forget about greeting people.][198866]} {[They would like to work faster but not at the risk of damaging the relationships needed to get the job done.][198885]} {[They understand there is a job to do.][198907]} {[But it can only be done right with the appropriate information, which takes time to collect.][198916]} {[When used appropriately, understanding communication styles can help resolve conflict on teams.][198933]} {[Very rarely are conflicts true personality issues.][198946]} {[Usually they are issues of style, information needs, or focus.][198954]}

{[Section C][198965]}

{[Hippocrates and later Galen determined there were four basic temperaments: sanguine, phlegmatic, melancholic and choleric.][198969]} {[These descriptions were developed centuries ago and are still somewhat apt, although you could update the wording.][198985]} {[In today’s world, they translate into the four fairly common communication styles described below:][199003]}

{[Section D][199019]}

{[The sanguine person would be the expressive or spirited style of communication.][199022]} {[These people speak in pictures.][199035]} {[They invest a lot of emotion and energy in their communication and often speak quickly.][199041]} {[Putting their whole body into it.][199056]} {[They are easily sidetracked onto a story that may or may not illustrate the point they are trying to make.][199063]} {[Because of their enthusiasm, they are great team motivators.][199082]} {[They are concerned about people and relationships.][199092]} {[Their high levels of energy can come on strong at times and their focus is usually on the bigger picture, which means they sometimes miss the details or the proper order of things.][199100]} {[These people find conflict or differences of opinion invigorating and love to engage in a spirited discussion.][199133]} {[They love change and are constantly looking for new and exciting adventures.][199149]}

{[Section E][199163]}

{[The phlegmatic person – cool and persevering – translates into the technical or systematic communication style.][199181]} {[This style of communication is focused on facts and technical details.][199197]} {[Phlegmatic people have an orderly methodical way of approaching tasks, and their focus is very much on the task, not on the people, emotions, or concerns that the task may evoke.][199209]} {[The focus is also more on the details necessary to accomplish a task.][199239]} {[Sometimes the details overwhelm the big picture and focus needs to be brought back to the context of the task.][199252]} {[People with this style think the facts should speak for themselves, and they are not as comfortable with conflict.][199273]} {[They need time to adapt to change and need to understand both the logic of it and the steps involved.][199293]}

{[Section F][199315]}

{[Tile melancholic person who is soft-hearted and oriented toward doing things for others translates into the considerate or sympathetic communication style.][199319]} {[A person with this communication style is focused on people and relationships.][199340]} {[They are good listeners and do things for other people – sometimes to the detriment of getting things done for themselves.][199352]} {[They want to solicit everyone’s opinion and make sure everyone is comfortable with whatever is required to get the job done.][199374]} {[At times this focus on others can distract from the task at hand.][199396]} {[Because they are so concerned with the needs of others and smoothing over issues, they do not like conflict.][199410]} {[They believe that change threatens the status quo and tends to make people feel uneasy, so people with this communication style, like phlegmatic people need time to consider the changes in order to adapt to them.][199430]}

{[Section G][199468]}

{[The choleric temperament translates into the bold or direct style of communication.][199472]} {[People with this style are brief in their communication – the fewer words the better.][199482]} {[They are big picture thinkers and love to be involved in many things at once.][199498]} {[They are focused on tasks and outcomes and often forget that the people involved in carrying out the tasks have needs.][199514]} {[They don’t do detail work easily and as a result can often underestimate how much time it takes to achieve the task.][199525]} {[Because they are so direct, they often seem forceful and can be very intimidating to others.][199547]} {[They usually would welcome someone challenging them.][199564]} {[But most other styles are afraid to do so.][199573]} {[They also thrive on change, the more the better.][199583]}

{[Section H][199594]}

{[A well-functioning team should have all of these communication styles for true effectiveness.][199598]} {[All teams need to focus on the task, and they need to take care of relationships in order to achieve those tasks.][199608]} {[They need the big picture perspective or the context of their work, and they need the details to be identified and taken care of for success.][199631]} {[We all have aspects of each style within us.][199657]} {[Some of us can easily move from one style to another and adapt our style to the needs of the situation at hand-whether the focus is on tasks or relationships.][199667]} {[For others, a dominant style is very evident, and it is more challenging to see the situation from the perspective of another style.][199699]} {[The work environment can influence communication styles either by the type of work that is required or by the predominance of one style reflected in that environment.][199722]}

{[Some people use one style at work and another at home.][199750]} {[The good news about communication styles is that we have the ability to develop flexibility in our styles.][199762]} {[The greater the flexibility we have, the more skilled we usually are at handling possible and actual conflicts.][199781]} {[Usually it has to be relevant to us to do so, either because we think it is important or because there are incentives in our environment to encourage it.][199801]} {[The key is that we have to want to become flexible with our communication style.][199813]} {[As Henry Ford said, “Whether you think you can or you can’t, you’re right!][199828]} {[”][199842]}

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 1 - 8:

Reading Passage 3 has eight sections A-H. Choose the correct heading for each section from the list of headings below.

Write the correct number i-x in boxes 1-8 on your answer sheet.

List of Headings

i      Summarising personality types

ii     Combined styles for workplace

iii    Physical explanation

iv    A lively person who encourages

v     Demanding and unsympathetic personality

vi    Lazy and careless personality

vii   The benefits of understanding communication styles

viii Cautious and caring

ix    Factual and analytical personality

x     Self-assessment determines one’s temperament

questions.explanationHtml:
iii
​Trong bài đọc, theo Hippocrates, có 4 loại chất trong cơ thể có tác động đến "tính cách" của 1 con người.
​=> Section A/ iii Physical explanation => sự giải thích về vật chất (do các "hợp chất" trong cơ thể là những vật chất).

vii

Trong bài đọc, mỗi cá nhân có cách học, giao tiếp, giải quyết vấn đề khác nhau, sự cá nhân hóa này giúp cho việc giải quyết xung đột giữa nhiều người. Bởi vì, khi xảy ra xung đột, việc chúng ta nhận ra là người đối diện không phải đang cố gắng tỏ ra khó khăn, mà họ cần những thông tin khác những thông tin bạn cần.

=>Section B/vii The benefits of understanding communication styles. (Lợi ích của việc nhận thức là có nhiều phong cách giao tiếp khác nhau.)

i

Trong bài đọc, Hippocrates và Galen đã rất quyết tâm trong việc tổng hợp các tính cách cho 4 loại " temperaments" ("tính cách").

=> Section C/i Summarising personality types.

iv

Trong bài đọc, mô tả "sanguine person" là dạng người có khả năng nói chuyện với một người lạ một cách thoải mái và họ có cách nói chuyện "có hồn" ( spirited style of communication).

=> Section D/iv A lively person who encourages => một người giàu sức sống.

ix

Trong bài đọc, "Tile phlegmatic" là một tuýp người thực dụng, họ chủ yếu giao tiếp dựa trên tính "kỹ thuật" và tập trung vào thực tế hơn là cảm xúc.

Section E/ix Factual and analytical personality => Người có tính thực dụng và phân tích.

viii​

Trong bài đọc, "Tile melancholic" là tuýp người giàu tình cảm (soft-hearted) và họ thường rất quan tâm đến các mối quan hệ xung quanh. Họ là người biết lắng nghe và hay làm việc tốt giúp người khác.

=> Section F/viii Cautious and caring. (Cẩn thận và quan tâm người khác)

v

Trong bài đọc, "The choleric temperament" là tuýp người rất tập trung vào công việc và quan trọng kết quả làm việc, do đó nhiều lúc họ quên là những người đang thực hiện công việc nào đó, được họ giao, cũng có các nguyện vọng riêng.

=>Section G/ v Demanding and unsympathetic personality. (đòi hỏi cao và không nhân nhượng)

ii

Trong bài đọc, một đội nhóm làm việc hiệu quả cần hội đủ tất cả các phong cách giao tiếp như kể trên để có được hiệu quả tốt nhất trong công việc

Section H/ii Combined styles for workplace. =(Các phong cách gộp lại cho một tổ chức)

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 9 - 13:

Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 3?

In boxes 9-13 on your answer sheet, write

TRUE               if the statement agrees with the information

FALSE              if the statement contradicts the information

NOT GIVEN    if there is no information on this

questions.text: It is believed that sanguine people dislike variety.
questions.explanationHtml:
False
​
Trong bài đọc, "The sanguine person" nhận thấy xung đột và bất đồng về ý kiến (conflict or differences of opinion) có ích (invigorating) => Họ chấp nhận sự khác nhau về quan điểm.
​
9 It is believed that sanguine people dislike variety.(sanguine people không thích sự đa dạng) => False.

questions.text: Melancholic and phlegmatic people have similar characteristics.
questions.explanationHtml:
True
​
Trong bài đọc, "tile melancholic" và "phlegmatic people" cần thời gian để thay đổi bản thân và thích nghi với tình huống.
​
10 Melancholic and phlegmatic people have similar characteristics. => 2 nhóm này có tính cách khá giống nhau. =>True

questions.text: Managers often select their best employees according to personality types.
questions.explanationHtml: Not Given

questions.text: It is possible to change one’s personality type.
questions.explanationHtml:
True
​
Trong bài đọc, trong chúng ta có những người có thể dễ dàng chuyển từ phong cách này qua phong cách khác tùy vào tình huống.
​
It is possible to change one’s personality type.(Việc thay đổi kiểu tính cách của 1 người là hoàn toàn có thể xảy ra) =>True

questions.text: Workplace environment can affect which communication style is most effective.
questions.explanationHtml:
Trong bài đọc, môi trường làm việc có thể tác động đến phong cách giao tiếp, tùy thuộc vào tính chất công việc hoặc phong cách làm việc chung của 1 tổ chức cụ thể.
​
=>Workplace environment can affect which communication style is most effective. (Môi trường làm việc có thể quyết định là phong cách giao tiếp nào là tốt nhất.) =>True

Question 14:

Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D.  

Write your answers in box 14 on your answer sheet.

options.text: improve one’s relationship with the employer.

questions.explanationHtml:
B
​
Trong bài đọc, sự tự đánh giá bản thân sẽ giúp chúng ta hiểu hơn về giá trị bản thân, và từ đó, sẽ thấu hiểu hơn người đối diện.
​
14+B =The writer believes using self-assessment tools can help to understand colleagues’ behaviour. (Tác giả tin rằng việc sử dụng các công cụ đánh giá bản thân sẽ giúp chúng ta hiểu hơn về hành động của đồng nghiệp.)
